parser_quality_control.review_notes: Table 1 is not merely a sequence table; it also carries Kd and IC50 columns with row-level peptide values. Table 2 remains computational and is not encoded as activity.

source_cautions.detail: IC50 and percent inhibition rows measure S-RBD:ACE2 interaction antagonism, not confirmed viral replication inhibition.
Supplementary Table S5 shows VERO-E6 infection blocking could not be confirmed for peptides 1-6.
A few narrative SD/mean values differ from Table 1; row-level values use Table 1 and preserve the discrepancy as cautions on affected rows.
